story.overview:
Create a unified StatusUpdater abstraction for status message handling so that both Slack handlers (user-message and app-mention) share consistent status logic. This reduces code duplication, improves testability, and centralizes status message management.
Currently, user-message.ts uses setStatus() via Assistant API (no debounce, Slack handles rate limiting), while app-mention.ts uses chat.postMessage/update/delete with manual 300ms debounce. This story introduces a common interface with two implementations and a factory function.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Create src/slack/status/types.ts with StatusUpdater interface containing three methods: update(status: string): Promise<void>, cleanup(): Promise<void>, isActive(): boolean. StatusContext type includes setStatus?, client: WebClient, channel: string, thread_ts: string, traceId?: string.

Create AssistantStatusUpdater in src/slack/status/assistant-updater.ts that wraps setStatus() callback. update() calls setStatus with loading_messages array, cleanup() calls setStatus(''), no debouncing. Graceful error handling - never throws, logs warnings.

Create ChannelStatusUpdater in src/slack/status/channel-updater.ts using chat.postMessage/update/delete. Implements 300ms debounce on update(), tracks messageTs internally, cleanup() deletes status message. Graceful error handling - never throws, logs debug messages.

Create factory function createStatusUpdater(context) in src/slack/status/index.ts. Returns AssistantStatusUpdater if context.setStatus exists, otherwise ChannelStatusUpdater. Factory is synchronous, no async initialization.
Refactor user-message.ts: Remove inline safeSetStatus function, import createStatusUpdater, replace all status calls with statusUpdater.update()/cleanup().
Refactor app-mention.ts: Remove updateStatusMessage/deleteStatusMessage functions and statusMessageTs/lastStatusUpdate variables, use createStatusUpdater instead.
Create unit tests in src/slack/status/index.test.ts covering both implementations, factory selection, debounce behavior, and error handling. All tests pass: pnpm test src/slack/status/
All existing handler tests pass: pnpm test src/slack/handlers/ with no regression in status behavior.

relevant-sections.section: Architecture defines StatusUpdater interface with update(), cleanup(), isActive() methods. Two implementations: AssistantStatusUpdater (wraps setStatus) and ChannelStatusUpdater (uses chat.postMessage/update/delete with 300ms debounce). Factory function createStatusUpdater() selects implementation based on context.setStatus presence.
Every handler must wrap entire body in try/catch, never throw, return structured results. Applied to StatusUpdater: graceful error handling, log warnings, never throw.
All relative imports MUST use .js extension: import { x } from './module.js'
Include traceId in every log entry, use logger.* methods not console.log, event names use {component}.{action} format.
src/slack/status/ directory with types.ts, assistant-updater.ts, channel-updater.ts, index.ts (factory + re-exports), index.test.ts

patterns-to-follow.pattern: Never throw from status updater methods. Catch all errors, log with traceId, continue gracefully. Use logger.warn for AssistantStatusUpdater (user-visible impact), logger.debug for ChannelStatusUpdater (less critical).

StatusUpdater interface: update(status: string): Promise<void>, cleanup(): Promise<void>, isActive(): boolean StatusContext: { setStatus?, client: WebClient, channel: string, thread_ts: string, traceId?: string }
Synchronous factory - no async initialization. Select implementation based on context.setStatus presence. Return interface type, not concrete class.
300ms debounce for ChannelStatusUpdater to avoid Slack rate limits. Track lastUpdate timestamp, skip updates within debounce window. First update (postMessage) is not debounced.
SetStatusFn may return void or Promise. Check if result is thenable before awaiting.
